findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "evm" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fx_rate, crypto_price · Private data: evm_balances_bulk, payment_verify, sanctions_check, evm_token_info, evm_allowance, evm_nonce, evm_gas_estimate, nft_info, fx_rate, crypto_price, evm_token_balance, evm_wallet_balance, evm_tx, ens_resolve, evm_call, evm_block, evm_code · Public sink: ens_resolve.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fx_rate, crypto_price · Private data: evm_balances_bulk, payment_verify, sanctions_check, evm_token_info, evm_allowance, evm_nonce, evm_gas_estimate, nft_info, fx_rate, crypto_price, evm_token_balance, evm_wallet_balance, evm_tx, ens_resolve, evm_call, evm_block, evm_code · Public sink: ens_resolve

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
